dataset: Real public records for the Sheffield LLRW disposal site, Bureau County, Illinois.

report/sheffield-cy2023-monitoring-repor.description: 2023 Radiological Environmental Monitoring Report for Sheffield Low-Level Radioactive Waste Site. 71 pages: site history, hydrology (two groundwater pathways), monitoring-location maps (Appendix A, pp. 23-27), and sample results (Appendix D, pp. 46+).
report/sheffield-cy2023-monitoring-repor.source: Illinois Emergency Management Agency and Office of Homeland Security (IEMA-OHS), Office of Nuclear Safety

data/tritium_2023.csv.description: Tritium (H-3) results for on-site water samples, CY2023, pCi/L. '<MDC' = below the Minimum Detectable Concentration.
data/tritium_2023.csv.source: Table D.3, pp. 49-50 of the report above. Transcribed by hand from the PDF (the tables are images); verify against the PDF before publishing.
data/tritium_2023.csv.notes: The report contains no coordinates for the sampling locations. Locations are shown in the maps of Appendix A (Figure A-2, p. 24).

data/sheffield_site.geojson.description: Site centroid point and approximate site boundary polygon (WGS84).
data/sheffield_site.geojson.source: Digitized in QGIS from the location figures in the IEMA CY2023 report (Figure 1, Appendix A). Approximate — verify against the report before publication.
data/sheffield_site.geojson.notes: Monitoring well locations are in data/wells.geojson.

data/tl_2023_17011_linearwater.zip.description: Streams and linear water features, Bureau County IL (full-resolution shapefile).

data/tl_2023_17011_areawater.zip.description: Lakes and area water features, Bureau County IL (full-resolution shapefile).

data/wells.geojson.description: Monitoring well locations (29 points, WGS84). Property 'id' = well number as used in Table D.3 (e.g. 563, 575, 577); null where the figure label was unreadable.
data/wells.geojson.source: Digitized in QGIS from the monitoring-location maps in the IEMA CY2023 report (Figure A-2, p. 24). Approximate — the report publishes no coordinates; verify against the report before publication.

epa_tritium_mcl_pci_l.source: US EPA National Primary Drinking Water Regulations, 40 CFR 141.66
